hints.title: Alphabetic Digit Conversion
hints.text: Replace each character in s with its 1-indexed alphabetical position, forming a concatenated digit sequence.

hints.title: Iterative Digit Summation
hints.text: For k iterations, sum the individual decimal digits of the current number representation.

hints.title: Converting to String for Re-Summing
hints.text: Convert the integer sum back to a decimal string to proceed with subsequent summation rounds.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Initial character-to-string expansion followed by repeated digit summation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary-precision arithmetic is not needed as digit sums shrink rapidly to small values.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: String representation easily handles large concatenated initial numbers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle character offsets correctly and simulate k rounds cleanly.
